cases.title: The late ACH file question
cases.prompt: What do we do when the inbound ACH file is late?
cases.context: [doc: runbook-ach-late-file §3] When an inbound ACH file is late past 06:00, page the payments on-call, open a P2 incident and notify treasury operations within 30 minutes.
